items.headline: Air Quality Alert issued November 21 at 11:04PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The Department of Environmental Conservation has issued an Air
Quality Alert which is IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM AKST SUNDAY.

North Pole has a Stage 2 alert.

Fairbanks has no alert.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 21 at 10:12PM AKST until November 22 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility 1/4 mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make travel conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 21 at 8:20PM AKST until November 22 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 65 to 80 mph.

* WHERE...Unalaska and Nikolski.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are expected before
midnight and will then slowly diminish through early Sunday
morning.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 21 at 2:56PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Minor coastal erosion and high surf conditions are expected for
parts of the West Coast as a Bering Sea low passes by Sunday
through early Tuesday. Primarily South to Southeast wind
directions could help water levels reach 2-4 feet above the mean
high tide level. No flooding is expected.
items.areas: Lower Kobuk Valley; Baldwin Peninsula; Northern Seward Peninsula; Shishmaref; Bering Strait Coast; Southern Seward Peninsula Coast; Eastern Norton Sound and Nulato Hills; Yukon Delta Coast

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 21 at 2:23PM AKST until November 22 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp, including Isabel
Pass.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 21 at 12:29PM AKST until November 23 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Elevated coastal water levels of 1 to 2 feet above the
normal highest tide line.

* WHERE...Coastal Kuskokwim Delta Communities, including Kipnuk,
Kongiganak, and Kwigillingok.

* WHEN...3 AM Sunday to 3 AM AKST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Elevated coastal water levels driven by southeast
winds gusting to 55 mph. Coastal erosion is possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Gusty southeasterly winds will begin
increasing early Sunday morning as the storm approaches.
Highest water levels expected late S
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
Precautions should be taken to protect property, such as securing
or moving property away from the shoreline.
